description: Pin + validate the Faddeev Phi_b substrate-regime b-map (b = sqrt(t/2pi) e^(i pi/4), q = 1/q0) at both anchors: contour vs modular-double product, shift equations, Phi(0) closed form, dual-face suppression quantified.
tier: infrastructure-validation (no c_k, no wiring, no fits)

assertions.name: S1b_branch_relation_neg_conj
assertions.detail: log Phi_(b_-)(z) = -conj(log Phi_(b_+)(z)) at z in {0, 0.008}: abs resid 1.5e-47 (same phase, inverted modulus)

assertions.name: S5_double_product_equals_contour
assertions.detail: P/Phi = 1 at both anchors (worst rel 1.1e-39, kmax=1153)

assertions.name: S6_dual_face_suppressed_at_real_z
assertions.detail: compact half-product vs Phi_b at z=u: rel 2.8e-40 (dual half ~ |q~|^(1/2) ~ 1e-83)

result.b_map: b = sqrt(ln q0 / (2*pi)) * exp(+i*pi/4); q = exp(2*pi*i*b^2) = 1/q0
result.verdict: SUBSTRATE REGIME PINNED + VALIDATED: at real q0 > 1 the Faddeev b-map is b = sqrt(ln q0 / 2pi) * e^(+i pi/4) (q = 1/q0, dual q~ = e^(-4pi^2/ln q0) ~ 1e-164; the previously-documented arg b = -pi/4 branch is the inverse-conjugate object log Phi_(b-) = -conj(log Phi_(b+)) -- same phase, inverted modulus -- and does not support the product form). Contour evaluator, modular-double product, both shift equations, modular invariance, and the Phi(0) closed form all agree at both anchors. Dual face is ~1e-82-suppressed at real substrate-scale arguments (S6) => the c3 S-leak CANNOT be a real substrate-scale-argument dual-face readout (scope-(a)); the argument search must probe the c_b lattice / complex arguments or compact-face differences. NO c_k derived; NO wiring.
